prompt:
Output exactly two lines only.

Line 1 (tags) — required format and rules:
- Provide a comma-separated list of up to 8 tokens (no punctuation except commas).
- First token must contain the main object as a lower-case common noun; it may optionally include a count (digit or word) after the noun (examples: "child 2", "child", "person one"). If a count is included, place it immediately after the noun in that first token.
- After the first token, list 2–4 salient visible objects and up to 1–2 clearly visible attributes (color or size). Order by salience (most important first) but free ordering is allowed.
- Use only lower-case common nouns and basic adjectives (person, child, dog, car, red, small). Do NOT use proper nouns, brand names, inferred facts, emotions, events, or dates.
- Include colors/sizes only when clearly visible; if uncertain, omit them.
- No repeated synonyms, no articles, and no verbs in tags.

Line 2 (caption) — required format and rules:
- One factual short sentence (7–14 words) in present simple or present progressive; main object must appear early in the sentence.
- If a numeric count is visually certain, include it (digit or spelled-out number allowed). If uncertain, omit the count rather than guess.
- Verb morphology: for a singular main-object count use third-person singular verb (-s); for plural use base verb (e.g., "1 child stands", "2 children stand").
- You may include at most one clearly visible color or size in the caption and one simple spatial relation/preposition (on, in, near, by, in front of, behind).
- Use only concrete, directly visible facts. Do NOT add proper nouns, inferred intentions, emotions, or invented facts.
- No punctuation except an optional single period at the end.

Harmonization and anti-hallucination:
- Ensure the caption contains at least one exact token (noun or visible attribute) from Line 1 so tags and caption reinforce the same salient visual terms.
- Prefer omission over guessing: if a property (count, color, relation) is not clearly visible, leave it out.
- If you cannot produce a compliant 7–14 word caption without adding uncertain attributes, produce a concise fallback caption of 2–3 words in the form "<main noun> <location>" (e.g., "child sidewalk") or "image unclear". In this fallback case Line 1 may still list visible tags.
- If you cannot produce even tags reliably, Line 2 must be "image unclear".

Self-checks (must be applied before returning output):
1. Exactly 2 lines in the output.
2. Line 1: ≤8 comma-separated tokens; first token = main noun (optionally with count); all lower-case; no forbidden items.
3. Line 2: either 7–14 words (preferred) or valid 2–3 word fallback; main object early; correct verb form when a count is present.
4. No proper nouns, inferences, or invented facts.
5. No punctuation except commas in Line 1 and an optional final period on Line 2.
If any check fails, replace Line 2 with the fallback "image unclear" (or, if tags cannot be produced, ensure Line 2 is "image unclear").

Implementation note for the pipeline (meta instruction, not required in the two-line output):
- When possible in the calling system, generate 3 short caption variants and use an external CLIP-based reranker to select the best-scoring caption. This often improves image-text alignment. The VLM itself should still follow the two-line output rules above.
